articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Effective Detection of Breast Cancer By Using Mammogram Data
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Progressive MS lesion formation is a primary cause of cognitive decline and physical impairment, making MS one of the major disorders. The rate of disease progression and the efficacy of treatments depend critically on having a quick and accurate method for assessing the number and size of MS lesions in the brain. The position, size, morphological variation, intensity resemblance with normal brain tissues, and inter-subject anatomical variance of MS lesions in brain MRI make precise diagnosis, characterisation, and quantification exceedingly challenging. In this paper, we explored a technique for detecting and segmenting MS lesions in which the fundamental processes are background creation and binarization with a global threshold. To link the normal tissues close to the margins, we perform a three-phase level set and then add a third-phase segmented region using a contour of the brain. To create an adaptable setting, we must first eliminate lesions from the brain, saving only the brain's largest linked area and the corpus callosum. Selecting the threshold using entropy and standard deviation via the binarization approach is followed by non-gamut image enhancement. The proposed method detects lesions in the same locations as a radiologist and with the same precision in terms of size and number. As a result of its flexibility, the suggested method has a range of applications in clinical practise for identifying MS lesions in MRI. When compared to more contemporary methods, the proposed method has a smaller margin of error and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of High-Speed MIMO FSO System In Various Data Formats
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Free space optical communication (FSO) is a technology that uses laser light for the propagation of information signals. FSO technology provides many advantages, but climatic variations make long-distance transmission ineffective. In this paper a hybrid combination of multiple input multiple output (MIMO) technique and Wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) technique with FSO system was utilized. Moreover, Gaussian pulse generator (GA), Return to zero (RZ) and Non-Return to zero (NRZ) data formats are used for the performance analysis of the proposed system. The Results show that the NRZ data format is suitable for a higher transmission range and the GA data format is suitable for a lower transmission range. To compile the results, the OptiSystem software is used. In the simulation study, the bit error rate (BER) and quality factor (Q-factor) has been used to evaluate the results.

articleTitle: Land Use Land Cover Classification in Remote Sensing Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Machine Learning techniques are popular and effective means for Land Use Land Cover (LULC) classification using remotely sensed data. These techniques are capable to deal with high-dimensional data, which is a major concern in the domain of remote sensing. Literature indicated the effectiveness of Machine Learning (ML) for complex classification of land cover classes. However, it is a challenging issue to select the appropriate classifier. The main objective of this paper is to implement and evaluate the most popular machine-learning techniques for LULC classification using remotely sensed data. The selected ML techniques are Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), k-Nearest Neighbor (kNN), and Random Forest. The chosen study area is Nanital district situated in Uttarakhand, India. In this research work, Sentinel-2 satellite data (10m spatial resolution) has been utilized. Results revealed that Random Forest achieved the highest accuracy (OA) of 91.56% (kappa value of 0.899). It is found that the ANN classifier produced the lowest classification accuracy of 88.16 and a kappa value of 0.859. Other classifiers like SVM and kNN obtained an OA of 90.72% and 89.64% and kappa values of 0.889 and 0.876 respectively.

articleTitle: Study Into The Application of Electroencephalogram (EEG) Signal Analysis For The Diagnosis of Taste Disorder
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Everyone relies on their sense of taste to select the most healthful foods and drinks for their daily diets. If one's sense of taste is impaired, one's ability to take in the nutrients necessary to maintain health will suffer. Doctors can usually detect a taste issue by observing the patient's reaction to a known tastant Modern imaging techniques, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), can also be used to identify taste disorders. This thesis proposes a method for detecting taste disorders using Electroencephalography (EEG). The suggested method includes acquiring an EEG signal, processing that signal to remove any sounds or disruptions, extracting features to make the data smaller, and using a classifier to determine if the person is healthy or suffering from a taste condition. New pre-processing and feature extraction methods were proposed after we conducted a comprehensive literature study, compared existing methods qualitatively, and identified shortcomings. A novel modified gamma filter is offered as a pre-processing filter for the recorded EEG data in order to reduce the impacts of artefacts and interference. Mean square error (MSE) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) are used to evaluate the effectiveness of the suggested pre-processing filter (PSNR). According to the results, the modified gamma filter outperforms the Blackman FIR, Butterworth IIR, and Gamma filters on average by 35.62 percent, 24.6 percent, and 9.15 percent in terms of mean squared error (MSE), respectively.

articleTitle: A Computer-Aided Detection (CAD) System for the Recognition of Prostate Cancer Grounded on Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work describes in detail a computer-assisted diagnosis method for examining prostate MPMRI scans for signs of malignancy after segmentation. By constructing a tumour probability map, we may identify areas of interest that are statistically likely to contain malignant tumours. We've pinpointed the areas of the prostate where these suspicious structures might be hiding. In this research, we present a framework for detecting prostate cancer in segmented images and predicting the lesion grade with the help of PIRADS guidelines, both of which improve the accuracy of the diagnosis. The PZ is not the only area of the prostate where our approach can detect cancer; the TZ and CZ can also be analysed. We've created a rule-based technique for localising suspicious spots inside the prostate's several zones, using probabilistic data on cancer's presence and mapping attributes. Classifying a lesion as either “clinically significant” or “not clinically significant” is an important step. The PIRADS scoring system is an effective method for classifying tumours in a medical setting, as it may be used to estimate the likelihood that a lesion is malignant or benign. We have applied the PIRADS criteria for confirming cancer in several geographic regions. Classification tasks are performed using the K-NN classifier, the Softmax classifier, and the Random Forest classifier that we have included in our research. Each tumour is assigned a score between 1 and 5 according to the PI-RADS criteria.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Pothole Detection & Instance Detection Based on A Unified Approach For Globally Roads
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This work investigated the Pothole Identification and Instance Detection based on a Unified Approach to Global Roads. In this research, we developed Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) model to predict if a road is smooth or has potholes. Also, a Deep Neural Network(DNN) model was developed for instance detection. The research was carried out on the image dataset consisting of binary forms of smooth roads & potholes. The CNN model detected the instance on that side of the roadway. The bulk of pothole detection and instance detection research was based on deep learning techniques like CNN, DNN and Long-Short Time Memory. We succeeded to obtain an accuracy of 87% and a probability of 0.5348807 for pothole detection model. The experimental outcomes demonstrated the efficiency of the DNN methodology for instance detection.

articleTitle: IOT-Based Accidental Detection System (ADS) Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Now a days, with the rising demand for vehicles, the rate of accidents is also increasing. Speedy roads like expressways where people avoid the idea to stop and help the victim. Victims of accidents happening on isolated roads also die due to a lack of immediate help. Due to these reasons, the rate of these deaths is rapidly rising. In this paper, we propose a device that can be installed in vehicles that can detect an accident and inform the nearest hospital automatically. Which will prevent the delay in reaching the accident spot and contribute to saving lives.

articleTitle: H-Plane Substrate Integrated Waveguide Horn Radiator For 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The millimetre wave (mmW) high speed, wide bandwidth, antennas are required for the current generation of radiators for high-speed vehicles like trains, airplanes, and satellites. The substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) technology reduces the losses above 10 GHz frequencies and is a most fascinating technique for the current and future generation of mmW applications. An optimum H-plane horn radiator with high gain, wide bandwidth, and low penetration losses is proposed on multilayer dielectric substrates (Rogers RT5880 (thickness = 0.79 mm) and Rogers RO3003 (thickness = 0.75mm)) of size 27.66 x 35.06 mm<sup>2</sup>to cover 26.33-35.55 GHz frequency range (bandwidth 9.22 GHz). The proposed single port SIW H-plane horn radiator exhibits radiation efficiency of 96.25-98.2%, and 6.07 - 9.6 dBi gain in -10 dB return loss frequency band.

articleTitle: Wideband Patch Antenna For Stable Radiation Pattern Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A triple-layered patch antenna was proposed in this study for generating wide bandwidth and stable radiation pattern. In order to obtain a symmetrical pattern of radiation, two slots were engraved at the bottom layer of the structure. A normalized radiation intensity of 20.4dB along with a max. field intensity of 1.34xl04 V/m were obtained and wide bandwidth was exhibited at more than one resonant frequency for the proposed structure.

articleTitle: Enhanced Image Compression Using Fractals and Principle Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Fractal image compression is a lossy approach that makes efficient use of the picture's inherent redundancy using affine transformations. It has been discovered that the traditional method of searching for domain blocks in fractal images requires a considerable amount of encoding time. As a result, in order to raise the speed-up ratio, a hybrid architecture that combines fractals and the discrete cosine transform (DCT) with PCA has been developed in this study. The proposed hybrid design cuts down on the amount of time needed by employing a relatively small number of components, and it offers compression ratios and quality levels that are satisfactory.

articleTitle: Deep Transfer Learning With Multi-Level Features Extraction Approach For Breast Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Breast cancer is a deadliest disease worldwide among the women. By some means early detection is very important to overcome it by prognosing on time. Deep networks having promising performance for different signal and image processing applications, breast cancer classification is one of the applications to diagnose efficiently. Deep transfer learning approaches are one of its kind and are using nowadays to overcome the computational time increase the performance as well. Sparse deep network such as VGG19 and ReasNet50 etc. are giving low performance but these are light weight and can be trained fastly. So, to increase the performance of the systems designed using these networks is an important issue, intermediate features are collected to overcome the vanishing gradient problem hence the performance can be improved. Here in this work histopathology images are used from which breast cancer is diagnosed. VGG19 deep network is considered as backbone network which is light weight, easy to implement and can be trained fast. Transfer learning is adapted to solve the problem of training the network from scratch. All the intermediate stage features are concatenated and finally these feature maps are feeded to fully connected deep network. Finally, classification is done with the help of SoftMax classifier. The proposed model is giving 96.43% accuracy which is better as compare to the existing state of the methods.

articleTitle: An Effective Identification of Flavor Complaint By Adaptive Analysis of Electroencephalogram (EEG) Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The ability to discriminate among various foods and materials for consumption is essential for maintaining a balanced diet and lifestyle. If one's sense of taste is impaired, one's ability to take in the nutrients necessary to maintain good health is compromised. A person's reaction to a recognised tastant is typically used by doctors to identify a taste problem. Analysis of brain images captured by cutting-edge equipment like MRI can also help in the diagnosis of taste disorders. In this paper, we present an Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based technique for detecting taste dysfunction. The proposed method begins with the collection of an individual's EEG signal, then moves on to pre-processing that signal to remove any noises or disturbances, then features are extracted to make the data set more manageable, and finally a classifier is used to label the signal as coming from a healthy individual or one with a taste disorder. We were able to offer novel methods for pre-processing and feature extraction thanks to a thorough literature analysis that included a qualitative comparison of existing methods and the identification of gaps. We propose two new feature extraction algorithms-the Hilbert Huang transform with independent component analysis (HICA) and the Hilbert Huang transform principal component analysis (HPCA)-to cut down on the raw data volume of the EEG. Algorithms like ICA, DWICA, PCA, and DWPCA are used to benchmark the suggested algorithms' performance in terms of % of variance.’ As a percentage of variance, the suggested HICA and HPCA method performs better than the state-of-the-art approach.

Index Terms: Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

articleTitle: Edge Detection and Color Mapping Based Diabetic Retinopathy From Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a serious disease which affects vision of diabetic patients. This may cause partial and complete blindness. There are so many works have been carried in the field of Diabetic Retinopathy diagnosis but still lacking somewhere. Proposes system uses the hybrid technique to build the system effectively and performance has been enhanced in all manners. The proposed system is based on Sobel Edge Detection and Color mapping techniques; where fundus images are processed constructively and obtain better level of accuracy. Fundus image contains exudates and the principal task of color mapping is to transfer the color to another pigment that enhances the visibility of exudates. The objective of color mapping is to calibrate the color and adjust it accordingly as per the visibility of background and foreground. There is a bit difference between the color of exudates and normal cells or blood vessels. Color mapping classifies the exudates and blood vessels; that definitely contribute to extract the features more precisely. System uses Sobel Edge Detection for extracting the horizontal and vertical edges. It calculates the gradient of fundus image intensities at each pixel. It can extract the shape of exudates, and density can be computed; that later compare with the threshold value. The proposed system uses Messidor benchmark for testing the system and pertained higher accuracy as compare to the previous model.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Low BER with High Speed 16 Channel WDM Communication Network for 5G and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In the high speed internet world bandwidth requirement increases because of many large bandwidth required applications such as video calling, online classes, large size video files transmission 5G, Internet of things applications etc. Wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) network obtains popularity for providing high bit rate and bandwidth in the optical communication system. WDM communication technology provides bi-directional transmission with high data speed but the transmit data by the WDM communication channel can affected by the internal and external disturbance. Internal disturbancedue to the internal devices can compensate by choosing appropriate parameters. In WDM communication system the bit error rate (BER) depends on data rate, attenuation constant of optical fiber, length of optical fiber link and wavelength spacing between the channels. This paper design and gives the optimum parameter values of 16 channel WDM optical communication system with low bit error rate and analyse the effect of wavelength spacing, input power and attenuation constant on minimum value of BER.

articleTitle: Removal of Artifacts In EEG Signals Using Sign Based LMS Adaptive Filtering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The electroencephalogram (EEG) has been used for many years to help doctors diagnose and assess conditions affecting the brain. An electroencephalogram is a specialized diagnostic tool for monitoring brain activity electrically. Human brain anomalies and responses to stimuli can be deduced from EEG recordings. The presence of extraneous signals, known as artefacts, can cause distortion in EEG recordings. Since these aberrations introduce spikes that can be mistaken for neurological rhythms and since the properties of practically all biomedical signals vary with time, it is challenging to evaluate the EEG. Therefore, in order to guarantee an accurate analysis and diagnosis, noise and unwanted signals must be removed from the EEG. The identification of artefacts, or any potential deviation that has a source other than the brain, is a critical issue in this field. Artifacts can originate from a variety of sources, including the undesired movement of the eyes and eyelids, breathing, bodily movements, power line interference, muscular, cardiac activity, etc. The computational complexity is the primary subject of extensive research into adaptive filtering algorithms. The goal is to create a variety of novel ANC's for denoising EEG signals while taking into account computing complexity, Signal-to-Noise Ratio, Mis-adjustment, and convergence difficulties. This is done by taking into account three types of adaptive algorithms: The Least Mean Square (LMS) Adaptive algorithm and its several weight update variations.

articleTitle: A Review On Hybrid Electric Vehicle Drive And Its Controlling Using Optimized Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The growing demand of vehicles and exponential increase in the consumption of fossil fuel for transportation is putting a massive burden on the environment by increasing pollution levels by the emission of various harmful gases. This problem has given birth to an opportunity to work in the field of alternative option to fossil fuel based vehicles. This paper presents a complete model of a Hybrid Electric vehicle(HEV) which incorporates the best features of both Internal Combustion based engine and Electric Vehicle. This work presents a MATLAB/Simulink based model of hybrid electric vehicle with a controlling algorithm to control the operation of electric motor, generator and internal combustion engine(ICE). With the help of simulation results, the proposed work is verified it was observed that this method has a significant effect on reducing the Internal Combustion engine dependency of Hybrid Electric Vehicle. The proposed method aims to provide a lesser use of Internal Combustion engine without reducing the performance for a Hybrid Electric Vehicle.

articleTitle: Advance Model For Ransomware Attacking Data Classification And Prediction Using Ai
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In the past few years, ransomware attacks have grown quickly and become a huge security problem for businesses of all sizes, governments, and internet users. Ransomware attacks are getting harder to pull off because encryption technology is getting better, and computers are getting more powerful. Then, to deal with ransomware successfully, you need to use effective methods. There have been a lot of different ideas about how to find ransomware, but none of them have worked very well. This means that more research is needed in this area. In this paper, A new way is proposed which will tell the difference between harmful software like ransomware and real programs by using techniques from process mining. The proposed method classifies ransomware by first using process mining to figure out the process model from the events logs. Only then does the model's features get pulled out. This needs to be done before the model's features are taken out. The results of this research show that ransomware can be found by using a method that combines classification strategies and process mining.

articleTitle: High Isolation 2-Element MIMO for WLAN/Sub-6GHz (n77, n78 and n79) 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss efficient antenna techniques in the sub-6GHz range with the use of wide band (WB) principle and to design the compact antennas for wireless access points. In addition to providing wider bandwidth, high data transmission at low power levels and a distinct radiation pattern, unique design approach and ease in fabrication is preferred. In order to achieve the desired antenna size, reduction in mutual coupling and improvement in the correlation coefficient (ECC must be below 0.5) and improved parameters of MIMO performance within acceptable ranges. This paper investigates the role of single-element MIMO with optimized structure consists of partial ground of dimension <tex>$(\mathbf{Wg} \times \mathbf{Lg})\ \mathbf{2}\times \mathbf{12}\ \mathbf{mm}^{\mathbf{2}}$</tex> and substrate <tex>$\mathbf{12}\times \mathbf{18}\ \mathbf{mm}^{\mathbf{2}}\ (\mathbf{W}\times \mathbf{L})$</tex> with the integration of 5G services for portable devices. The asymmetrical patch and feed point principle is used for the implementation of 2-element multiple MIMO array with structure of dimension <tex>$(\mathbf{W}\ \times\ \mathbf{L})\ \mathbf{36}\times \mathbf{18}\ \mathbf{mm}^{\mathbf{2}}$</tex>. The -10 dB frequency range of 3.1 to 5.6 GHz is achieved along with increase in gain. A number of MIMO parameters were measured such as correlation coefficient, Isolation among neighbouring patches, several gain components and other performance parameter in today's wireless communication technology. Since, the transition from SISO (Single Input Single Output) to MIMO (Multiple Input Multiple Output) occurred last century.

articleTitle: An Effective Classification of Ddos Cloud Based Attack Through Tree Founded Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The term “cloud computing” refers to a relatively new technology that provides users with access to various computing services and resources, including software, data storage, and communication infrastructure. There are currently certain security concerns with cloud computing. An Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is a form of network security that monitors for malicious activity. In the cloud, an IDS might operate on individual hosts or over an entire network. DoS attacks, which aim to disrupt, disable, or otherwise harm a service, have become increasingly common against cloud applications and internet services. Due to the cloud's complexity and decentralized nature, it is difficult to detect attacks on its infrastructures. Moreover, by allowing a wide variety of smart devices to access cloud-based infrastructures, it raises both the difficulty and the complexity of assaults. A decision tree is a method of categorization used in data mining. It is recommended to utilize this method when developing a classification scheme from a reclassified data set. Classifiers such as the Classification and Regression Tree (CART), C4.5, and the Random Tree (RT) are proposed in this work. The utilized CART method has a tendency to generate additional trees on nodes, until no tree can be formed judging whether or not a node is terminal. Because of its adaptability, the CART technique can handle gaps in the data. The tree is pruned to make it smaller and more manageable in C4.5. A classifier's complexity is decreased while its prediction accuracy is improved. Decision trees were used to generate the chain of basic decisions used in RT's label assignment process.

articleTitle: W-Net Plus: Dnn For Spatial Saliency Prediction In Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have been employed recently to identify saliency in images and videos. Different models have been suggested to predict spatiotemporal as well as temporal and spatial saliency. In this study, a model called W-net Plus is proposed for predicting spatial saliency in videos. The newly proposed model not only translates information from the encoder to the decoder but also from the decoder to the encoder, and it is inspired by U -net architecture. The proposed model has been evaluated by the author(s) on various data sets, and they have obtained noteworthy findings for the F - Max, structural similarity (S-measure), and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) measurement parameters, demonstrating its effectiveness and survivability. No stage of the training involves the utilization of transfer learning in the work.

articleTitle: Pre-Processing Investigation For Brain Abnormality Detection And Analysis Through MRI of Brain
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Both men and women face equal risk from conditions such brain tumours, strokes, blood clots, and multiple sclerosis (MS). The most frequent and prevalent of these brain illnesses is a brain tumour. The prognosis and therapy for a brain lesion depend on how quickly and precisely it is diagnosed. However, neuroradiology experts are the only ones qualified to make the diagnosis, as it is extremely difficult. Each medical report from an imaging investigation must be reviewed and confirmed by at least two physicians. If there's a problem, it could mean a biopsy or even surgery. This study describes a fully automated procedure for removing artefacts and the skull from magnetic resonance (MR) pictures of the brain by utilising computational geometry, wavelet decomposition, and thresholding. The intermediate step of correct preprocessing of MR images is thresholding using the standard deviation method. For various MR images, the suggested preprocessing approach achieves a high degree of accuracy with a small error rate. This preliminary processing is employed to lessen the likelihood of erroneous detection. As a result, the accuracy with which diseases are diagnosed using brain MRI by a computer system is improved.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction Based Domain Kickout Method For Fractal Image Compression
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In fractal image compression, similarities between the picture's self-similar components, often known as fractals, are exploited in order to create a novel method of image representation. In order to depict these fractals, it makes use of affine transformations. The significant amount of time needed for the encoding process is this method's most significant drawback. In this paper, we propose a fast fractal image compression system. This system works by reducing the effective number of domain images by using feature extraction, which in turn reduces the computational overheads and ultimately results in a reduction in the amount of time it takes to encode the image.

articleTitle: Detection of Tuberculosis Bacilli Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A harmful bacteria known as MT is the primary cause of the communicable disease tuberculosis (TB) (Mycobacterium Tuberculosis). This disease can be treated but because of its contagious nature, it comes under the category of the world's scariest as well as the deadliest disease. From this point of view, the detection of Tuberculosis (TB) at a very early stage is mandatory to provide successful treatment and then prevent it from spreading to other people also. Due to their efficiency and inexpensive cost, microscopy tests using ZN-stained images are typically favored in underdeveloped nations. However, manual detection of TB bacilli under a microscope is a very time-consuming and tedious task. In the proposed work patch wise detection strategy using CNN is done for which a set of image patches are extracted from the supplied list of annotated images. The patches were then categorized into negative and positive patches. Data augmentation is used to balance out the quantity of positive and negative patches.

articleTitle: The Current State of Software Engineering Employing Methods Derived from Artificial Intelligence and Outstanding Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Although AI has become a buzzword for self-organizing IT applications; its significance to software engineering has not been rigorously examined. To evaluate the current state of advancement, the potential for future development and the risks of AI application to software engineering, this study combines a systematic review of previous research in the field with five qualitative interviews with software developers who use or want to use AI tools in their daily work routines. Research organises findings about the software improvement life sequence. Results show that AI's greatest achievements and potential lie in three areas: a) the systematic evaluation of these data in neural networks; b) the structured analysis of big data pools to discover patterns and novel information clusters; and c) the automated automation of lengthy routine jobs in software development and testing using algorithms, such as for debugging and documentation. As a result, AI shortens the development cycle, reduces expenses, and increases productivity. AI has thus far been dependent on human-made structures and has primarily been reproductive; nonetheless, the automation of software engineering jobs has a major advantage: the creative capacity of human developers is multiplied when using AI tools effectively.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Two Way Sign Language Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Hearing disabilities affect people all over the world. Nearly 360 million people have a disabling hearing loss. Due to birth abnormalities, accidents, and oral diseases, the number of people who are deaf and dumb has dramatically increased in recent years. The objective of our project is to form a bridge between the hearing-impaired community and the hearing community; to further commence a two-way communication. A two-way sign language translator that converts Voice to sign language and vice versa in real time is proposed using Convolution Neural Network (CNN) model and raspberry pi module. The model provides 99% accuracy.

articleTitle: 4×4 Rectangular Shape Microstrip Patch Antenna-Array With DGS For 5G Wi-Fi Communication Application
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Microstrip Patch Antenna (MPA) is gaining considerable attention due to its small size and high performance. MPA suits electronic gadgets and wireless communication devices under 4G and 5G communication. This paper presents a design of a 2×2 and 4×4 rectangular shape MPA array designed and fabricated for a 5G wireless communication system. Four different frequencies, 4.1 GHz, 4.5 GHz and 5.5 GHz, with a maximum Gain of 7.69 dBi and bandwidth of 829 MHz, are obtained. The design is based on the cutting-edge design of a rectangular shape patch antenna with the partial ground. The hardware design is made from a double-sided copper Printed Circuit Board (PCB). The antenna is fabricated with FR-4 Epoxy substrate, which is tested and compared to the simulated results in an experimental test.

articleTitle: Multi-Keyword Graded Exploration in Encrypted Cloud Data for Industries Based on Rc4+ and Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The vast amounts of storage space offered by the cloud encourage businesses to store their most sensitive files and data on remote servers accessible over the internet. When comparing a local server and personal computer to a cloud environment, it's clear that many more tasks can be accomplished with the former. Cost, speed, global scalability, productivity, and performance are just a few of the six reasons why cloud services have gained popularity among businesses and consumers alike in recent years. This paper presents the River cypher RC4+ (RCPF) scheme for fast, efficient, and secure multi-keyword search indexing in an encrypted cloud environment. In order to encrypt and decrypt data, the RC4+ algorithm uses a final symmetric secret key that is created by a pseudorandom byte generator. In order to generate an index list for each file in a shorter amount of time, a minimal spanning tree is formed. After that, the encrypted index list is searched by the cloud server, and relevant files are ranked according to the search query. The user's decryption of the encrypted data using the symmetric key behaves as a whole.

articleTitle: Delineation of Flooded Areas Using A Synergistic Combination of Optical and SAR Imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Optical Satellite imagery is very useful in mapping floods. However, optical sensors can operate during day time only and cannot capture images of impacted areas during cloud cover. As such, Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data is very useful due to its unique ability to penetrate clouds and ability to capture images during day and night. The primary objective of this study is to obtain the flood inundation map by leveraging the potential of high-quality optical (Sentinel-2) and SAR (Sentinel-1) imagery using machine learning techniques. The dataset consists of four 10m spatial resolution Sentinel-2 optical bands integrated with dual-polarized (VH, VV) Sentinel-1 bands along with four Sentinel-2 spectral indices. Four Machine learning classifiers (Random Forest (RF), Rotation Forest (RoF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and k Nearest Neighbors (KNN)) were used to obtain the flood inundation Maps. All the classifiers obtained good accuracy in the range of 88% to 91%. Rotation forest achieved the best performance among all classifiers with an overall accuracy of 91.2% and a kappa score of 0.881.

articleTitle: Multichannel EEG Pattern Acknowledgment Feature Assortment Using T-Test Ranking and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive test used to assess human brain activity by utilizing signals generated from the brain; it is also used to detect epileptic seizures. Furthermore, this helps medical professionals identify conditions including epilepsy, seizure, sleeplessness, sleepiness, traumatic brain injury, headache, and brain tumor. It's also useful for establishing that a person has died of a brain injury. Epilepsy is a condition of the nervous system brought on by electrical spikes and waves. Epilepsy manifests itself in moments of amnesia, unconsciousness, and involuntary twitching. A person's behavior can have a significant impact on the activity of the brain's neurons. Some bodily functions are also affected by the shift in neuronal activity. Sensory, visual, and memory processing all occur in the brain in line with the flow of electrical signals. When the brain's nerve cells are compromised, a seizure results. Generalized seizures and focal seizures are the two main categories. This study proposes that for supervised learning tasks, it is possible to achieve better results using multichannel EEG recordings by selecting features with maximal class separability. In this study, we test the following theory: One definition of a good feature subset is one in which the features have a strong correlation with the class labels but no correlation with one another.

articleTitle: Cluster Based Hidden Markov Model For Path Improvement In Mobile Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In order to carry out some operation, the radio propagation wave is used by a wireless system that is dependent on a network of nodes. Wireless networks are frequently thought of when discussing the telecommunications network. By definition, a wireless system is a collection of components (or subsystems) that can perform some set of tasks through the use of electromagnetic wave propagation and does so in a reliable manner. Starting in the 1980s, wireless cellular networks relied on a centralized infrastructure. Roaming users maintain a constant connection to the wireless network at all times via access points. Mobile wireless sensor networks (MWSN) have had a mobility management strategy described for them utilizing a Hidden Markov Model (HMM). The metrics Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI), Link Loss, and Expected Transmission Count are used to foretell a node's mobility (ETX). To begin, we set up a prediction timer during which we record both the received signal strength indication (RSSI) and the link failure rate (Link Loss). The HMM-based predictions are activated when either the RSSI or the Link Loss decreases from their previous values. If not, the timer will automatically reset and a new one will begin counting down.

articleTitle: Automatic Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Inability of irrigation systems to monitor when crops have received the proper amount of water and when these crops are facing scarcity, these issues are solved but require user input, manual connection to the water supply, and some level of technical expertise but they are not automated. This research paper defines an automated irrigation system that does not have any of these limitations. The automated irrigation system measures the soil moisture content and wirelessly enables the pipeline to open when the moisture content drops below the minimum threshold for the cultivated crop and identifies the land to be irrigated. When the moisture level rises above the defined maximum value, the system deactivates the irrigation pipeline, stopping land irrigation. This automated irrigation system is compatible and can also be used to upgrade existing drip irrigation systems around the world, surface irrigation systems, and sprinkler systems.

articleTitle: Wavelet Transform and Cascaded Feed Forward Neural Network Analysis of Electromyographic Data For Involuntary Detection of Hand Gesticulation
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Hand gesture acquisition refers to the process whereby a computer is able to detect and record human hand movements. Vision-based hand gesture detection and a data glove-based approach can do this. In the realm of vision-based methods, we find both static hand and real-time hand gesture detection approaches. Five flex sensors are sewn onto the glove for the data glove method. Compared to the data glove-based method, the vision-based method is more consistent and robust. Designing a user-friendly vision-based interface, however, is a formidable challenge. The collected hand motions will need to be manually categorised by the user once again. So, it's no surprise that deciphering data is a laborious process that eats up plenty of time. This analysis should ideally be done mechanically. Relating the electrical nature of the human nervous system to computers presents a significant challenge in the field of Human Computer Interaction (HCI). Electromyographic (EMG) impulses, which change depending on the sort of hand motion utilised, are used to establish a brain link with computers. Because of this, an EMG-based system for recognising hand gestures can be created. The goal of this research is to create signal processing methods and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) that can automatically recognise hand motions. The recorded Electromyographic (EMG) signals for a wide variety of hand motions are analysed using signal processing techniques, from which a number of features are extracted. Characteristics are extracted using Wavelet Transform (WT) based techniques including Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and Wavelet Packet Transform (WPT). Better performance was achieved with the recommended methods, as shown by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Sleep Disorder Detection through PSD-Based Short-Time Frequency Analysis of Electrocardiogram Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Sleep problems are now the most frequent health issue people experience nowadays. According to studies, about 20% of the global population has some sort of sleep disturbance. As a result, lots of folks are popping Ambien to get some shut-eye. One in five patients has a sleep disturbance, as 20.3% of those who visit the doctor ask for sleep aids. As a result, mortality rates are rising not just in India but everywhere. Therefore, the intelligent computing approach has been developed to help both patients and hospitals deal with sleep disorders and the consequences that come from them. Many people's health can be improved by the development and implementation of an intelligent computing method for the identification of sleep disorders. The proposed approach incorporates widely used feature selection methods such as FFT and PCA, and compares their results to those obtained using TQWT to locate peaks in ECG signals. As measured by the sum of peaks extracted from ECG data, TQWT was shown to be more effective than both FFT and PCA. As a result, preventing sleep disorders from worsening makes diagnosis a top concern.

articleTitle: A Smart Tele-Healthcare System for Real-Time Health Monitoring and Remote Consultation
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: This paper presents a new concept of health observation and connectivity to Medicinal experts at a distance. In the present era, the Internet of Things (IoT) is changing the way technology infrastructure functions. This work presents, an IoT -based smart health monitoring system to provide medicine on time using continuous screening of the heart rate, oxygen level, and body temperature of an individual. A system having heartbeat sensor, temperature sensor, SpO2 sensor based on Arduino platform with cloud Sheets API have been designed to implement the proposed system. The primary function of the presented approach is to consider two sensors at input for improving clinical care for cardiac patients by providing early intervention and improved 24-hour monitoring. The proposed IoT-based system enables data sheet preparation for real time upload and remote consultation in case of any variation in the heart rate, oxygen level, and temperature to provide medicine promptly.

articleTitle: The Application of Hybrid Optimization For FIR Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In this research, the finite impulse response (FIR) filter design procedure is analyzed with use of novel design technique of optimization while considering the specified parameters. This technique will define the coefficients in optimized form for the different FIR filters- LP, HP, BP and BS filters with the objective of getting the desired frequency response. The error function of filter is considered as an optimization function in which the values for δp and δs are specified individually. A new optimization algorithm is undertaken in this with the utilization of a hybrid technique composed of Bat and Seeker optimization. The design is implemented with the use of various optimization approaches as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Seeker, Bat and Hybrid of Seeker and Bat optimization innovations in order to fulfil the ideal impulse response attribute of FIR filters. Furthermore, the comparative analysis of all the techniques is presented in terms of the variant attributes of FIR filters and also for the different orders of FIR filters. The hybrid approach depicts its superiority in comparing the design results of all the techniques and it shows the best results among all.

articleTitle: An Experimental Testbed For Rssi-Based Indoor Localization With Lora
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is the nova emergence of connecting devices, people, and objects over the internet as sensors and actuators for a targeted application. Among popular IoT applications, location based IoT services are curtailed. Where the geographical location of a moving object will be estimated based on signal strength values using algorithms. To estimate the locations using algorithms distance measurement such as Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) is required. In this research, we design and implement a cloud based IoT architecture to collect RSSI data of a moving sensor node using three reference nodes. LoRaWAN-based hardware is used for publishing the onsite data on the remote storage server. The hardware design of the experimental testbed includes the implementation of the mobile node, reference nodes, and IoT cloud architecture to send RSSI data. The target node is designed using Atmega328p and RFM69HW and reference nodes are designed on ATmea328p, RFM69HW, and ESP12F modules. The MQTT protocol is used to data storage. At the end of the research, the validity is checked by the linear relationship between RSSI acquired remotely with the Euclidean distances of each sample point. The results substantiate the linearity of the data sets which proves the validity of the research.

articleTitle: An Effective Analysis of Proficient Two Level Security Contraptions For Loading Data In Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: One of the cornerstones of the future generation of computing is cloud computing, a form of internet-based computing. It allows for the instantaneous allocation of Internet-accessible resources whenever they are needed. Services such as software as a service (SaaS), platform as a service (PaaS), and infrastructure as a service (IaaS) are made available to people and businesses through cloud computing. By giving customers a low-cost, scalable, and financially-independent place to store their data, cloud storage services have seen rapid revenue growth in recent years. An interoperable cloud computing system is built on open architectures and interfaces that support both private and public cloud services. Many businesses today are making the switch to the cloud because of the numerous advantages it offers in terms of data storage, retrieval, management, and availability. While cloud computing is receiving a lot of attention, it is imperative that security problems be addressed first. This study proposes a crypto-stegno mechanism in the cloud as a solution to cloud security problems. This study proposes a practical method for ensuring data privacy and security in cloud storage. In order to obtain their own public and private key, users must first register their information in the cloud and come up with a unique username and password. Cryptography, a means of concealing information and sending information in an unreadable format, is employed in the next level of security. Secure data transmission and storage on the web, electronic commerce, digital media privacy, and ATM transfer are all dependent on cryptography to some degree. Repudiation, integrity, authenticity, and confidentiality are all possible using today's cryptographic methods. Signcryption is a lightweight cryptographic system that combines encryption and signatures in a logical way to achieve higher security with less computing time.

articleTitle: Efficient Diffie Hellman Two Round Secret Key Agreement Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Diffie Hellman algorithm exchanges the secret key among the two parties over a public channel using asymmetric encryption. Whitfield Diffie modeled it, along with Martin Hellman in the 1970s, and named it Diffie Hellman. Diffie Hellman comes under the public key cryptosystem and is mainly used in SSH, IPsec, TLS, and PGP security protocols. We aim tosecure this algorithm from the threat of an implementation attack, a man-in-the-middle attack, and insider and outsider attacks. This paper made the secret key more secure by two-time key generation. We get our second shared secret key after applying the first secret key generation operation and taking its primitive root. Then we exchange both user's public keys so they can calculate their secret keys. This two-round key generation procedure will make more secure data transactions.

articleTitle: Smart Model For Career Guidance Using Hybrid Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Career guidance is required mostly for the degree students as they have not clear vision about it. Most students don't know what kind of work they want to do or what degree would be best for them. Considering the user's skills, interests, and preferences, the system will suggest different career paths. The results of this assignment can help students zero in on a subject area that fits their knowledge and interests the best. The Smart Career Guidance System using chatbot, is built using recurrent neural network (RNN) and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM). To proposed Smart Model for Career Guidance Using Hybrid Deep Learning Techniques. Our proposed hybrid deep learning algorithm work on the concepts of RNN and LSTM and Natural language processing (NLP).

articleTitle: Prediction Method For The Detection of Epilepsy In The EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The distinctiveness of EEG signals, which are a component of human biological signals, enables us to detect abnormal neurological activity, such as epilepsy, through pre-processing. Over the years, the use of EEG signal processing for predicting and detecting epilepsy has received significant attention. A straightforward method for recognizing epileptic events is proposed based on the recorded EEG signals. The linear prediction filter is applied to monitor seizure activity and predict the occurrence of spikes and sharp waves. This study analyzes the linear prediction mechanism by determining coefficients for each set of windows, with the goal of finding the superior model. The performance of the model is evaluated using the error value of the predicted signal. The results show that the energy of the prediction error signal during seizures is higher than during seizure-free periods, allowing for the identification and location of seizure intervals using the energy value. The proposed approach is evaluated using Receiver Operating Characteristics (ROC) analysis and outperforms existing methods.

articleTitle: Detection And Classification of Lung Cancer CT Images Using Mask R-CNN Based Generated Mask Method
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In the medical field, computer vision systems, and especially image diagnostics, provide a wide range of useful tools. Computed tomography (CT) scans are the gold standard for identifying a wide variety of medical disorders, from bone fractures to lung cancer to heart disease (CT). One of the top four mortality rate disease in the world is lung cancer. The lung areas are divided up for clinical diagnostics after being defined. This study suggests combining supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques with the CNN and model specialization using R-CNN for lung area mapping to separate the lungs in CT images automatically. Accuracy of 99.21%, sensitivity of 99.33%, and specificity of 98.97% were achieved by our approach to lung tissue classification using a combination of a Mask Region - Convolutional Neural Network (MR-CNN) and a support vector machine. We checked our results against the work of other scientists to be sure we weren't missing anything. Our solution outperformed other state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Content based Image Search Engine with Grey Wolf Optimized Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The systems with Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) approach enable the search and retrieval of images that are comparable to a particular query image by utilizing attributes that indicate the content visualization of such images. The present study created a mechanism for recovering images indexed in databases based on their visual information without the necessity for linguistic annotations. Feature vectors were obtained from the hybrid of DWT and LBP visual contents. The classification is achieved by using Grey Wolf optimized Neural Network (GWO-NN) technique. The proposed strategy yielded 95.59% accurate findings on publicly available databases.

articleTitle: Framework For Load Balancing Using Multi Resource Scheduling With Minimum Time Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The scheduling of appropriate resources for cloud workloads is a difficult task, as it depends on the quality of service needs of cloud applications. Due to their limited data storage and energy capabilities, loT applications demand high-speed data transfer and low latency. Many loT devices generate data continuously and want to store it on the cloud quickly and efficiently. Dynamic virtual machine (VM) allocation in cloud data centers (DCs) is taking advantage of the cloud computing paradigm. Each VM request is characterized by four parameters: CPU, RAM, disk, and bandwidth. Allocators are designed to accept as many VM requests as possible, considering the power consumption of the loT device's network. Resource scheduling and time consumption are the two most significant problems in cloud computing. To overcome this problem, in this paper, the author has extended CloudSim with a multi-resource scheduling and minimum time consumption model that allows a more accurate valuation of time consumption in dynamic multi-resource scheduling. The author proposes a new load distribution framework, TTS, which provides a better solution to other scheduling algorithms and also tries to reduce energy consumption and time to give a task to the VM.

articleTitle: Recognition of Normalization Grounded Adaptive Filtering Methods For Noise Cancellation In EEG Signal Recordings
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Electroencephalograms (EEGs) are promising tools for the diagnosis and treatment of neurological and mental disorders, and they are gaining ground as a measurement of brain activity. The electrical activity of the brain can be measured and recorded with an electroencephalogram (EEG). Electrodes are usually placed along the scalp and wired to a recorder to convey the data. The brain and spinal cord together make up the central nervous system, which controls every function in the human body. It receives data from the sensory organs, analyses and organizes it, and then decides what actions to direct the rest of the body to carry out based on that data. When a human brain is damaged, it can have catastrophic effects on every area of that person's existence. Accidents, assaults, concussions, lack of oxygen (near drowning), Alzheimer's disease and other degenerative diseases (dementia, Parkinson's disease), alcohol and other drugs, brain tumors, epilepsy, seizures, infections, and diseases (meningitis, encephalitis) are all examples of what are considered brain disorders. The goal is to design a variety of innovative ANC's for EEG signal denoising that address the challenges of computational complexity, Signal-to-Noise Ratio, Mis-regulation, and convergence. This is done by taking into account three types of adaptive algorithms: Adaptive algorithms with normalization.

articleTitle: Investigation of Seismic Signal Processing for Detection and Classification of Moving Unarmoured Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The concept of automatically recognising targets has been actively researched for more than three decades at this point. Despite this, research is still being conducted because the technology has so many potential uses, including monitoring of traffic and perimeters, surveillance, and so on. Research work that focuses on the performance of detection and classification algorithms is in high demand. The current body of work in research investigates potential methods for enhancing the efficiency of detection and classification procedures. The frequency of the seismic signal shifts throughout the course of time, which means that the signal is non-stationary. Using this method, the non-stationary signals are evaluated. The time-frequency representation of these signals does, however, contain the cross-terms in question. In light of this, our working hypothesis for this study is that getting rid of these cross terms will result in an improvement in the performance of the detection algorithm. As a result, an improved method has been suggested, which performs better than STFT and thus verifies the hypothesis that was proposed.

articleTitle: Improving The Quality of Real-Time Monitoring of Foetal ECG For Effective Extraction of Information
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Some methods of fECG extraction include many electrodes on the mother's body, while others just require one electrode to be put on the mother's belly, with a second, reference electrode (if necessary) attached to her chest. Currently, confirming the ECG of individual foetuses in cases of multiple pregnancies requires using multiple electrodes. Multiple electrodes are needed for fECG extraction, which can be painful for the mother and presents a clinical challenge. There has been some research into realising fECG extraction in hardware for use in real time. In most circumstances and according to other published methodologies, the best estimate is nothing more than an estimated foetal heart rate of >110 beats per minute. The signal is deemed too noisy and unreliable if the estimated foetal heart rate is less than 110 beats per minute throughout that time period. In addition, the suggested research demonstrated the feasibility of extracting fECG from multiple abdominal channels, with satisfactory findings obtained from each. Other potential avenues of application for real-time monitoring have been examined with the proposed research approach or it's related. The performance has been modelled and tested on high-end DSPs.

articleTitle: Heart Rate Variability Analysis From Electrocardiogram (ECG) and Photoplethysmogram (PPG) Signals By Using Soft Computing Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: The use of biomedical signal processing software to aid in the analysis and interpretation of electrocardiograms is not a new development but rather an established field of study. The identification of the QRS complex, P and T waves, and the measurement of the QT segment are crucial to the efficiency of an automatic ECG analysis system. Diagnosis of heart function and other crucial facts about the subject's cardiovascular activity can be gleaned through the detection and measurement of characteristic waves. To get a feel for your heart rate, for instance, you need to identify QRS complexes, which are then utilized as a benchmark for beat alignment. Myocardial infarction is also linked to morphological changes in the QT interval and elevation/depression of the ST segment (MI). R peak registration is the foundation for automatic peak detection and segmentation, including the identification of onset and termination times. The position of the QRS complex is indicated by the index of the R peak, or the index of the QS complex peak if the R peak is negative. In this study, researchers analyzed HR and HRV signals from a range of participants, including those of different ages, sexes, and heart problems. The detection of variations is done with the aid of statistical indices. During this process, we also create a database of electrocardiogram (ECG) and photoplethysmogram (PPG) readings from our lab. The peaks of the PPG are also picked up, and a comparison between the HR measured by the ECG and the PPG demonstrates that the PPG can be used as a substitute for HRV detection.

articleTitle: Research, Development and Analysis For Solar Power Gathering Instruments
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: There has been a dramatic increase in the development of electronic devices made from bonded organic compounds due to their unique electrical behaviour and photonics propensity, as well as the favourable conditions for their processing and low production costs. Beginning with large band gap polymers, this dissertation delves into the photo physics of an all polymeric system. Optical, electrical, and morphological analyses, among others, were used to better understand the working phenomenon of the nanostructure that was created to maximise efficiency through interfacial engineering. Then, utilising spray coating techniques, the devices were framed in non-fullerene topologies; this architecture improved device efficiency and kept air stable for up to 72 days without the need for encapsulation. A PCE of around 7.52 % has been achieved, which is the uppermost PCE recorded to time for the donor and acceptor used in this study. The fabrication process was carried out using a small-molecule architecture that proved effective and was constructed using a bulk-heterojunction design. Solvent engineering principles were used to design the active layer configurations by combining several solvents and applying them using the spray coating method. With 8.25% efficiency, small molecule-based donors are now competitive with their polymeric analogues. Next, the dissertation zeroes in on the Tandem device and Bio solar cell, two cutting-edge innovations that solve the problems plaguing traditional methods of renewable energy generation.

articleTitle: Dysarthric Speech Enhancement using Hybrid model involving Dynamic Time Warping and Feed Forward Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Any neurological impairment to the speech production system results in a range of motor speech disorders known as dysarthria. Speech quality is degraded in dysarthric speech, which is characterized by poor speech articulation. Therefore, it is crucial to enhance or correct dysarthric speech in order to help those who have the condition communicate more effectively. The purpose of this work is to enhance the continuous speech of many dysarthria sufferers. To enhance the intelligibility of speech, Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) with Artificial Neural Network (DTWANN) Speech Enhancement (SE) system has been used. Here, reconstructing the dysarthric signal from the speech signal has been focused on improving intelligibility of the speech. In order to process the dysarthric speech signal in the testing phase, the proposed SE system first trains an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model. Pairs of normal speech and dysarthric speech utterances is used for training. The outcomes demonstrated that the suggested strategy improves PESQ score to 2.550 which shows significant improvement over PESQ of 1.002 before enhancement.

articleTitle: A System For Automatic Recognition of Hand Gestures Based on Temporal Features and Feed Forward Neural Network By Using Electromyographic Data
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Typically a function of time, biomedical signals are defined as a set of electrical readings taken from any given organ. The term “electrical biomedical signals” is used to describe the variation in electric current that results from adding up the electrical potential difference throughout a certain tissue or organ. These electrical signals have a very small amplitude and a very slow frequency. Based on shared properties, the biological signals were clustered into distinct categories. Electromyography (EMG) signals are employed for hand gesture recognition among biological signals. That's the retrieved electrical potential from the muscle fibres being recorded. Electromyographic (EMG) signals are recorded using surface electrodes. Noises are amplified as the EMG signal is recovered from the muscle fibre and transmitted through various media. Despite the explosion of available spoken and written means of communication, people still rely heavily on hand gestures when trying to convey ideas and intentions. Therefore, HCI experts agree that recognizing hand gestures is crucial (HCI). As a result, computers can now detect and respond to user-initiated movements. Denoising and amplification are used as signal pre-processing steps. There are a variety of suggested methods for obtaining these properties. Time domain features extraction. Mean, standard deviation, energy, entropy, Skewness, and kurtosis are all employed as measures of statistical dispersion. Better performance was achieved with the recommended methods, as shown by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Realization of SWAP Gate using Electro-Optic Phenomenon-based Mach-Zehnder Interferometer
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: In this paper, the SWAP gate is realized using the electro-optic (EO) phenomenon in the Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (MZI). In the structuring of the SWAP gate, two MZI is being used, and output is obtained from the bar port of both MZI. The SWAP gate output is obtained from MATLAB by using the mathematical description of MZI. The proposed layout of the SWAP gate is designed using titanium diffused lithium niobate (Ti:LiNb03) waveguide and simulated using the beam propagation method (BPM) at 1.33 μm wavelength.

articleTitle: K-Means Clustering & Wavelet Based Texture Feature Set For Brain Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Brain tumors and brain cancer can have varying prognoses based on factors such as tumor type and location, patient age, and overall health. Early detection of brain tumors is crucial for saving lives, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a fast and safe method for detecting these tumors. However, there is a need for non-invasive and efficient brain image analysis techniques to aid in tumor detection. This paper presents a technique for brain image analysis that utilizes k-means clustering to segment images and wavelet transform to extract features. A total of 22 texture features are extracted and normalized before being submitted to a classifier. The dataset of 253 brain images is classified as tumor or non-tumor using BPNN classifiers. The scaled conjugate gradient-based backpropagation neural network (SCG-BPNN) and bayesian regularization-based backpropagation neural network (BR-BPNN) are used for training. The BR-BPNN training algorithm outperforms the SCG-BPNN algorithm with an accuracy of 97.23%, although it takes longer to train. The proposed work is compared with other existing research and found to perform better in terms of classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Brain Abnormality Detection and Analysis By Using MRI of Brain Through Multiple Sclerosis Lesions Detection And Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Progressive MS lesion formation is a primary cause of cognitive decline and physical impairment, making MS one of the major disorders. The rate of disease progression and the efficacy of treatments depend critically on having a quick and accurate method for assessing the number and size of MS lesions in the brain. The position, size, morphological variation, intensity resemblance with normal brain tissues, and inter-subject anatomical variance of MS lesions in brain MRI make precise diagnosis, characterisation, and quantification exceedingly challenging. In this paper, we explored a technique for detecting and segmenting MS lesions in which the fundamental processes are background creation and binarization with a global threshold. To link the normal tissues close to the margins, we perform a three-phase level set and then add a third-phase segmented region using a contour of the brain. To create an adaptable setting, we must first eliminate lesions from the brain, saving only the brain's largest linked area and the corpus callosum. Selecting the threshold using entropy and standard deviation via the binarization approach is followed by non-gamut image enhancement. The proposed method detects lesions in the same locations as a radiologist and with the same precision in terms of size and number. As a result of its flexibility, the suggested method has a range of applications in clinical practise for identifying MS lesions in MRI. When compared to more contemporary methods, the proposed method has a smaller margin of error and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Dynamic Route Selection In Mobile Wireless Sensor Network For Analysis Of Cluster Grounded Energy Hop Calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: A sudden increase in the number of client stations or a shift in how they utilise multimedia services can quickly transform an otherwise uncongested network into one that is struggling to keep up. In order to predict an access point's future traffic load, its past data can be examined. The router's determination of the optimal path to the destination may be affected by factors such as the fluctuating number of client nodes in a Wireless LAN and the access point's fluctuating traffic load. Intelligent incorporation into congestion control algorithm or routing is necessary to take preventative measures before such a situation emerges. Early resource allocation in the network and guaranteed quality of service are both aided by an accurate forecast of network traffic at each access point. Taking into account the energy factors, path hops actually do not lead to efficient execution. To enhance service over the mobile wireless sensor network, we present a Cluster Energy Hop-based Dynamic Route Selection (CEH-DRS) that is based on production zones. In this case, sensor nodes can send and receive data packets independently. They also aid in the transmission of data packets originating from various nodes to their final destination.

articleTitle: Recognition Of Fes Using A Novel Detection Method Based On Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Currently, the wireless access method utilized by systems is 5G technology. In this study, a lightweight NN for emotion recognition is proposed, where a visual system can be incorporated into devices with a low computational capability to perform face expression classification while simultaneously minimizing the amount of parameters utilized in the classification process. To improve the reliability of the results, it is helpful to package the models as a service that other collaborating systems can use. Face expression resource development frameworks can be tailored to address the requirements of different security models, such as criminal threats, government secrets, etc. This model will have the opposite influence on detection and classification and produces good detection results by identifying photographs inside the dataset, which indicates that the model built into this research is suitable for multi- categorization of facial emotions. In general, comprehended a visual system that can be incorporated on devices with minimal computer capacity to attain result classification and decrease many factors. Following comparison with the algo in recent years, the accuracy of our algo will be higher than theirs, and it has achieved good detection results in photographs inside the dataset after the experimental results.

articleTitle: Concentrated Solar Power Plant With Central Receiver System For Rajshahi And It's Possibility In Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Concentrated Solar Power (CSP) is among the most significant forms of renewable energy generation because it converts solar heat into pollution-free electricity. Bangladesh has a significant potential to generate power from the sun's radiation due to its geographical advantage. This research proposes a 12 MW Central Receiver CSP plant for Rajshahi city, taking into account environmental issues and economic potential with “System Advisor Model (SAM)” software. According to our performance analysis results, the enhanced power plant would be able to deliver 37 GWh of electricity to the national grid each year while operating at a capacity factor of 39.1%. This paper's ultimate aim is to improve the study of CSP plants in Bangladesh for pollution-free generation and to reduce the country's relying solely on natural resources for power generation. This research also supports the green initiatives of the country to generate power.

articleTitle: An Automated Diagnosis of Diabetic Macular Edema Grading Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Diabetes affected millions of individuals till now, up from 108 million in past years, and the ratio is increasing daily. Age-specific diabetes mortality rates increased exponentially. Blindness is frequently brought on by diabetes. With medication, routine screening problems, and treatment for any that arise, diabetes can be controlled and its effects postponed or averted. Therefore, for earlier detection of diabetes-based disease, Diabetic Macular Edema is diagnosed using transfer learning deep models. The transfer learning is used on the pre- trained EfficientNetBO and ResNet50 models. The CNN layer and hyperparameters are added to these models to combat overfitting. Moreover, the dataset is well pre-processed and augmented using specific parameters to avoid misclassification and better model training.
