articleTitle: Fundus Image Enhancement Using Hybrid Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Imaging of the retinal fundus plays a main role in retinal disease diagnosis. Intricate information in retinal fundus images, such as small vessels, microaneurysms, and effusions, may appear unclear due to border artifacts, abrupt changes in colour levels, and uneven illumination which will result in poor diagnosis of retinal diseases. The existing retinal image enhancement methods mostly address either the vessel contrast or uneven illumination. Further preserving the edge features along with enhancing the contrast as well as adjusting the illumination is addressed in the proposed method. First, Haar Wavelet transform is applied to the retinal images followed by gamma adjustment to achieve a uniform and an improved illumination. Then the images are processed using a CofE-Net architecture with RSA and LQA modules to obtain an image along with basic background information. The image containing the background basic information is then merged with the original image to obtain a contrast improved fundus image. The proposed method achieves better results based on visual assessment as well quality parameters like PSNR, structure similarity measure, Enhancement measurement error and Edge based Contrast measurement.

articleTitle: Design Issues and Challenges of Memristor Structured Gas Receptive System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Memristors provide an efficient and reliable scope in the application of gas sensors. In recent years, technologies have progressed rapidly in meeting the demand for high density and low power semiconductors through innovative ideas on MOSFET, FINFET, memristors, etc. Hence, memristors provide a more reliable device for building a gas sensor. This paper mainly demonstrates on crossbar arrangement of memristors that can be used for sensing purposes to solve the integral problem of density and power. This work comprises a proposed flow chart for a gas sensing system that provides easy coding on a Verilog-A or SPICE module integrated with memristive characteristics. The crossbar arrangements with different existing array structures are elaborated. Comparative analysis of the previously proposed structures with their merits and demerits are presented.

articleTitle: A Survey On Deep Learning Approaches for Real-Time License Plate, Vehicle Type and Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Innovations in High Speed Communication and Signal Processing (IHCSP)
abstract: Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) is an image processing technology employed to identify vehicles by their license plates involving several steps such as detection, pre-processing, segmentation and recognition. Vehicle Type Classification (VTC) is very important in transport management systems, especially in real-time environment conditions. Classification and counting each vehicles type is still a challenge. Face recognition is the most trustworthy method in biometric identification and the most up-and-coming technology for security and password systems as it can detect the user with a minimum level of interaction. This study explores the approaches and methods used in ALPR systems, VTC systems, and Face Recognition systems, mainly focusing on Deep Learning techniques. Further, we analyze and discuss the related research to learn the best technologies to implement these systems with higher accuracy and performance.

articleTitle: Design And Optimization of An of Dm Transmission System For Optical Fiber Using Various Network Architectures

abstract: Wireless technology is one of the new developments in the field of communications and also wireless technology provides efficient data transfer and an increasing 4G and 5G networking framework in recent scenario. The definition of a multi-carrier modulation is specified by an OFDM system. The OFDM is affected by the disadvantage of high PAPR i.e. Peak to average power ratio. In this paper analysis of several strategies have been discussed: SLM (Selected Mapping), PTS (Partial Transmit Sequence), Tone Reservation, Clipping and Filtering, etc. to reduce the PAPR effect in OFDM systems. The study of various PAPR reduction strategies involves specific parameters such as distortion rate, data size, power increase etc.
